name: Apple Human Interface Guidelines
summary: A platform-native system where semantic roles, adaptive appearance, clear hierarchy, and respect for user agency matter more than decorative consistency across every device.
signature_traits: legibility and accessibility as system behavior
best_for: cross-device products that should feel at home on Apple hardware
interfaces where system behavior and accessibility should lead visual styling
avoid_for: brand experiences that require ignoring platform conventions
visual clones that hard-code system colors or imitate native chrome without native behavior
